enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn body to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Move arm. Turn to back. Adjust blanket. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Remain still.

Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and cereal. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and spoon. Close cabinet. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk from bowl. Stand up. Pick up bowl and spoon. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl and spoon. Place in dishwasher. Wipe table. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet door. Select shirt. Select pants. Select socks. Select shoes. Close closet door. Remove towel. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Apply deodorant. Pick up bag. Check bag contents. Pick up phone. Pick up keys. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock front door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to office. Clock in. Put on uniform. Greet colleague. Walk to workstation. Sit down. Turn on computer. Check emails.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient list. Walk to patient room 1. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Measure temperature. Administer medication. Record notes. Walk to patient room 2. Repeat. Attend team meeting. Discuss patient cases. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Return to workstation. Update patient records. Make phone calls. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Check patient list. Visit patient room 3. Assist with procedure. Record notes. End shift. Clock out.

Walk out of workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to house. Unlock front door. Enter house. Close door. Remove shoes. Hang up coat. Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Turn on TV.

Walk to kitchen. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cabinet. Take out cutting board and knife. Close cabinet. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Stir. Turn off stove. Open cabinet. Take out plate. Close cabinet. Serve food onto plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher.

Clear table. Scrape food scraps into trash. Stack plates. Carry plates to sink. Rinse plates. Load plates into dishwasher. Load utensils. Load glasses. Add dishwasher detergent. Close dishwasher door. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth. Wipe counter. Sweep floor. Take out trash. Replace trash bag. Wash hands. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out of kitchen.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body. Put on pajamas. Walk to bedroom.

Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to left side. Breathe slowly. Turn to right side. Adjust blanket. Stretch legs. Move arm. Turn to back. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Remain still.
